## Introduction

This report was written in Quarto and compiled with Typst.
It shows how a single Markdown source becomes a polished PDF, with proper typography, margins, and page numbering out of the box.

## How the pipeline fits together

Quarto hands your Markdown to Pandoc, which emits a Typst source file.
Typst then compiles that source into the final PDF.
The three stages share enough intermediate state that you can inspect, override, or replace any of them without rewriting your document.

## Summary

Start with a `.qmd` file, set `format: typst`, and run `quarto render`.
Everything on this page came from roughly a dozen lines of Markdown.
